items.resolution: Empty file/filter states and welcome screen are explicit; failed media has alternative text.
items.probe: What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media?

items.resolution: Folder loading sets wait cursor/status; rendering badge says Preparando lectura until completion.
items.probe: What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)?

items.resolution: Invalid path preserves current folder; malformed diagrams and missing images show isolated fallback.
items.probe: What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)?

items.resolution: Unreadable size metadata falls back to Markdown label; failed media does not abort document.
items.probe: What is shown for partial or incomplete data — some fields or rows present, others missing?

items.resolution: Route stays in main toolbar at 900px; diagram/table/code areas scroll independently.
items.probe: What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate?

items.resolution: Document title/path truncate with full tooltip; reading wraps and has no global horizontal overflow.
items.probe: What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow?
